phase3_findings.description: judgment-row crash (exit 1, no infra-marker) classified DRIFT → coordinator blocks the suite, violating AC5 fail-open-on-crash; capability-profile-literals and coverage-map-ratchet omit the traceback marker
run_preflight lacked a per-row guard; a late-row exception after a detected drift would propagate to the top-level net (exit 2, no summary) and the coordinator would fail open, losing the drift
run_preflight exit-2 path, drift-over-uncheckable precedence, and the judgment-row UNCHECKABLE/crash arms were untested by the real Python (only coordinator stubs)
run_preflight_row classifies preflight_argv exit codes against the row's argv-declared exits/clean sets; correct today because cloud-writer verify and generate share the (0,1)/(0,) contract
target-absent error string names the helper script rather than the output artifact; cosmetic, on the already-uncheckable path

fix_decisions.evidence: universal traceback→UNCHECKABLE guard in run_preflight_row (preflight-only, run_row unchanged); coordinator comment corrected; AP6 test drives it
per-row try/except in run_preflight loop preserves already-detected drift
added AP4 (exit-2 uncheckable), AP5 (drift-over-uncheckable precedence), AP6 (crash→uncheckable) real-Python arms
only cloud-writer diverges and shares the exit contract; per-row preflight_exits is YAGNI
cosmetic error string on an already-uncheckable path
